name: delete the fallback branch, so a card whose git state is known still says "git unavailable"
cache unconditionally, so the first timeout overwrites the good state and the fallback can never work again (the subtle one)
treat not_a_repo as transient too, so a deleted repo shows a fossil branch forever
stamp cached_at on a live state, so a fresh probe renders as a fossil
drop the cached_at stamp on a cache hit, so the age never renders and a fossil is indistinguishable from a live probe
construct GitState from the raw payload, so a schema change turns every cache hit into a TypeError and takes the dashboard down
return a default GitState instead of None when nothing was cached, so an unavailable probe claims a branch it never saw
persist only the branch, so the fallback renders a state that never existed
drop the ON CONFLICT clause, so the cache never updates after its first write
render the cached age with `ago` instead of `ago_epoch`, the filter that takes an ISO string
old: Project state indexed<time>{{ git.cached_at | ago_epoch }} ago
new: Project state indexed<time>{{ git.cached_at | ago }} ago
